summary: XORTX Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing termination of its investor relations agreement with IR Agency LLC, effective August 7, 2026, with funds returned on August 14, 2026. The IR program is postponed pending voluntary delisting from TSXV, expected September 1, 2026. Also announced transfer agent change to Computershare. Corrective disclosure of $240,000 finder's fees related to Vectus acquisition. This is a routine operational update, not a special-situation event of the categories listed.
